title: Noor and the Ghost
author: Quentin Vane
blurb: Ulyana Thornbury, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
